strips.title: A first winter with a jump starter — in real life

panels.head: October
panels.text: Pack goes into a drawer, half charged.

panels.head: November check
panels.text: A light tap shows two bars. Plug it in for the night.

panels.head: January freeze
panels.text: Car won't start. Pack spent the night indoors.

panels.head: Started
panels.text: Clamps on, light green, engine runs.
